title: Deorum CSMP
description: An optional modpack for the Deorum CSMP server.
body:
This is the official Modpack for the Deorum CSMP server intended to improve immersion in the roleplaying experience. The various optimization mods and quality-of-life features are all intended to improve performance for players on the server, and add some nice features to enhance the roleplay experience.

**Features:**

- Custom entity models, various animals and creatures can be seen as intended.
- Dynamic surrounding ambiance, immerse yourself in the world around you with bird song and fireflies.
- Shader support!
- Excalibur Resourcepack included.
- Entity culling and game optimization! Say goodbye to dropped frames during roleplay events!
